definition_of_done: Config supports enabling/disabling per-step screenshots and selecting artifact persistence mode without breaking existing defaults.
Unit tests cover config parse/merge behavior for screenshot-related fields across file, env, and CLI inputs.
Quality gate passes: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, and `cargo fmt --all -- --check`.

recommended.approach: Extend existing config structs and precedence logic first so all later screenshot tasks can read one canonical policy.

title: Add screenshot capture policy to runtime config
